sn7.12:1.2: Atha kho Bhagavā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaram ādāya yena Udayassa brāhmaṇassa nivesanaṃ tenupasaṅkami || || 3.
sn7.12:1.3: Atha kho Udayo brāhmaṇo Bhagavato pattam odanena pūresi || || 4.
sn7.12:1.4: Dutiyam pi kho Bhagavā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaram ādāya yena Udayassa brāhmaṇassa nivesanaṃ ten-upasaṅkami || pa || 5.
sn7.12:1.5: Tatiyam pi kho Udayo brāhmaṇo Bhagavato pattam odanena pūretvā Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn7.12:1.6: Pakaṭṭhako yaṃ samaṇo Gotamo punappunam āgacchatī ti || || Punappunam
sn7.12:6.1: Evam vutte Udayo brāhmaṇo Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn7.12:6.3: Upāsakam maṃ bhavaṃ Gotamo dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatan ti || || 1. Sāvatthi nidānaṃ || || 2.
